package.author: iterate GmbH
package.description: Cyberduck for mounting volumes in the file explorer.

en-US.author: iterate GmbH
en-US.description: Cyberduck for mounting volumes in the file explorer.
en-US.longDescription: Mountain Duck lets you mount server and cloud storage as a disk in the File Explorer on Windows. Open remote files with any application and work like on a local volume.
en-US.name: Mountain Duck
en-US.releaseNotes:
- [Feature] Enable file lock support when advertised in OCS capabilities (Nextcloud, ownCloud) (#18118)
- [Feature] Support ProxyCommand from ssh_config (SFTP) (#8688)
- [Feature] Create buckets with ACLs disabled (S3, Google Storage) (#18526)
- [Feature] Client-side checksum verification of uploads (S3, Backblaze B2, Dropbox, Google Drive, Google Storage, Box, OpenStack Swift) (#17352)
- [Feature] Retry with exponential backoff when the server rejects the connection (FTP, WebDAV)
- [Feature] Use regional endpoints for public URLs (S3) (#17301)
- [Feature] Remove deprecated Shared folder (OneDrive) (#17890)
- [Feature] Load connection profiles from the system-wide application data folder (Windows)
- [Feature] Pseudo file locking for Office formats opened in Euro Office and LibreOffice in "Smart Synchronization" connect mode
- [Bugfix] File Explorer stalls when monitoring directories in "Integrated" connect mode (Windows)
- [Bugfix] Failure to mount with "Specified cast is not valid" error in "Integrated" connect mode on Windows 10 prior to version 2004 (Windows)
- [Bugfix] File not marked in sync after opening in Microsoft Excel with no modification in "Integrated" connect mode (Windows)
- [Bugfix] Failure to select "Delete on Local Disk" for pinned files in "Integrated" connect mode (Windows)
- [Bugfix] Stalled operations, including opening a file, waiting for a lock held by a long running transfer in "Smart Synchronization" connect mode (macOS)
- [Bugfix] Switch default type for uploads to block blob (Azure) (#18386)
- [Bugfix] Overwriting files appends to existing file (SFTP) (#18335)
- [Bugfix] Handle timeout during resumable file upload finalization (ownCloud)
- [Bugfix] Support Pageant through OpenSSH agent named pipe configured in ssh_config, replacing the Pageant connector (SFTP, Windows) (#18479)
- [Bugfix] Disable SSH agent with IdentityAgent none in ssh_config (SFTP)
- [Bugfix] Resolve username from server after OAuth authorization (Nextcloud, ownCloud) (#18456)
- [Bugfix] Reuse TLS session for data connections with TLS 1.3 (FTP-SSL)
- [Bugfix] Cannot navigate into folders in hierarchical namespace (Azure) (#18455)
- [Bugfix] Skip reading ACLs of objects in buckets with object ownership enforced (S3) (#18526)
- [Bugfix] Select private key configured in bookmark in login prompt (#18516)
- [Bugfix] Cannot unset previously saved password in bookmark (#18518)
- [Bugfix] Offer RSA certificates with SHA-2 signature (SFTP) (#18478)
- [Bugfix] Reset cached proxy configuration on network address change (Windows)
- [Bugfix] "Server connections interrupted" dialog shown after sleep (macOS)
- [Bugfix] Opening Preferences triggers permission prompts for Desktop and Downloads folders (macOS)
- [Bugfix] Endless indexing for protocols comparing with ETag in "Smart Synchronization" connect mode
- [Bugfix] Directories listed again from server after every upload in "Integrated" connect mode (macOS)
- [Bugfix] New remote files in offline folder left as placeholders in "Integrated" connect mode (Windows)
- [Bugfix] Rename during upload is discarded or leads to duplicate folder in "Integrated" connect mode (macOS)

zh-CN.description: 用于在文件资源管理器中挂载存储卷的 Cyberduck。
zh-CN.longDescription: Mountain Duck 允许您在 macOS 的 Finder 和 Windows 的文件资源管理器中，将服务器及云存储挂载为本地磁盘。如同操作本地宗卷般，使用任意应用程序打开远程文件。
